title: Driving ability in chronic kidney disease
summary: It should be observed, how driving ability is given in different stages of CKD. There aren't any information available yet. So nobody can answer "who is allowed to drive" because there aren't any guidelines. Moreover, it is unclear in what extent dialysis effects driving ability. It is only known, that professional driver aren't allowed to work when they are patients under dialysis.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients capable of giving consent and cooperating
CKD stage min. G3a
Exclusion criteria:
criteria, that can effect cognitive tests (delir, dementia)
